WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.name AS product_name,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold
    FROM products AS p
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY
        p.product_id,
        p.name
),
product_ratings AS (
    SELECT
        r.product_id,
        AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating
    FROM reviews AS r
    GROUP BY r.product_id
),
sales_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ps.units_sold) AS avg_units_sold
    FROM product_sales AS ps
),
rating_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating
    FROM reviews AS r
)
SELECT
    ps.product_id,
    ps.product_name,
    ps.units_sold,
    ROUND(pr.average_rating, 2) AS average_rating
FROM product_sales AS ps
JOIN product_ratings AS pr
    ON pr.product_id = ps.product_id
CROSS JOIN sales_average AS sa
CROSS JOIN rating_average AS ra
WHERE ps.units_sold > sa.avg_units_sold
  AND pr.average_rating < ra.avg_rating
ORDER BY ps.units_sold DESC, ps.product_id;
